operations.setup: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm exec rer install
operations.verify: pnpm run verify && pnpm check:deployment-spec && pnpm exec rer check --profile first-party
operations.recovery: Follow docs/backup.md. Pause writes and scheduled work, retain the exact source revision and private settings, restore the owner-controlled encrypted backup into fresh empty resources, re-export and compare clinic data, then verify owner sign-in before routing traffic. Preserve all applied migration names and bytes.
